leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize two pointers to track positions in an array
Manipulate array elements by swapping non-zero values toward the front
Apply the two-pointer technique to separate zero and non-zero elements
Construct a loop that iterates through the array using both pointers
Update the array in-place without creating additional data structures
Control pointer movement based on element values during iteration
Implement the complete moveZeroes function using the two-pointer approach
